description: The lock D4-shape states: the lifecycle/glance commands reach ONLY the app's own local windows (the settings + glance views). No `remote` block means no remote origin — the arbiter page (External URL) gets NO IPC at all (tauri 2.12 authority.rs: resolve_access denies a command with no capability matching the origin/window; remote origins need capability.remote.urls, never set here).
